Secret Santa Generator

Draw Secret Santa pairs with a true derangement shuffle — nobody ever draws themselves. Reveal pairings or download them.

#Giver→Receiver
Enter names and press Draw names.

A derangement shuffle guarantees nobody draws their own name.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter one participant name per line (minimum 3).
  2. Press Draw names to generate fair pairs with no self-draws.
  3. Reveal the pairings or download them as a text file.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the drawing work?

It uses a Fisher-Yates shuffle and re-shuffles until no one is assigned to themselves (a derangement), which is the fair Secret Santa rule.

Can someone draw their own name?

No — the derangement guarantee means self-draws are impossible.

How many people do I need?

You need at least 3 participants for a proper Secret Santa draw.

How do I share the results?

Download the pairings as a text file to share, or read them aloud from the screen.

Is this private?

Everything runs locally in your browser.
